00010  ORG #6000
00020 CNT EQU 5
00030 LAB LD A,7*3+1/2
00040  LD HL,LAB+2
00050  DEFB 1,2,#FF,%101
00060  DEFW LAB,$
00070  DEFM /HELLO/
00080  DEFS 3
00090  LD A,100?7
00100  LD A,#F0&#3C
00120  LD (IX+5),A
00200  DJNZ $
00210  EX AF,AF'
00220  OUT (C),A
00230  LD B,CNT
00250  LD DE,2-5
00260  RET
00300 L.X NOP
00310 L_Y NOP
00320 L?Z NOP
00330 L@W NOP
00340 L$V NOP
00350  JR L.X

00370  LD HL,0-1
